title: Sovereignty, Constitutional Identity, and European Integration

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: In the 21st century, Hungarian constitutional discourse is shaped by the dialectic between national constitutional identity (*alkotmányos identitás*) and the supranational legal order of the European Union.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Debates in recent years have involved the EU's rule-of-law conditionality mechanism (*kondicionalitási eljárás*), the limits of EU competence and checks and balances (*fékek és ellensúlyok*). Present-day institutions and procedures change over time.
